from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import unquote

from fastapi import HTTPException

from .skill_library import SkillLibrary


CANONICAL_SKILL_SCHEME = "skills://"
LEGACY_SKILL_PREFIX = "xavi-runtime://skills/"


def skill_tool_manifest() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """MCP tools for progressive-disclosure skill discovery.

    Skill instructions remain read-only knowledge. Operational actions are exposed
    by their own bounded tool modules rather than embedded in a skill document.
    """
    return [
        {
            "name": "skills.list",
            "description": "List mounted agent skills as metadata only, optionally filtered by namespace.",
            "read_only": True,
            "input_schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {"namespace": {"type": ["string", "null"]}},
                "additionalProperties": False,
            },
        },
        {
            "name": "skills.read",
            "description": "Read one path-contained SKILL.md document after selecting it from skills.list.",
            "read_only": True,
            "input_schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "required": ["name"],
                "properties": {"name": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}},
                "additionalProperties": False,
            },
        },
        {
            "name": "skills.search",
            "description": "Search mounted agent skills and return digest-backed excerpts without loading every skill.",
            "read_only": True,
            "input_schema": {
                "type": "object",
                "required": ["query"],
                "properties": {
                    "query": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
                    "namespace": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
                    "limit": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 20, "default": 8},
                },
                "additionalProperties": False,
            },
        },
    ]


def _library(corpus_dir: Path) -> SkillLibrary:
    return SkillLibrary(corpus_dir / "skills")


def skill_resources(corpus_dir: Path | None) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    resources: list[dict[str, str]] = [
        {
            "uri": "skills://concretecms",
            "name": "Concrete CMS skill catalog",
            "description": "Metadata catalog for the mounted Concrete CMS Agent Skills collection.",
            "mimeType": "application/json",
        }
    ]
    if corpus_dir is None:
        return resources

    for item in _library(corpus_dir).list("concretecms").get("items", []):
        path = str(item.get("path") or "")
        parts = path.split("/")
        if len(parts) < 3:
            continue
        slug = parts[-2]
        resources.append(
            {
                "uri": f"skills://concretecms/{slug}/skill.md",
                "name": str(item.get("name") or slug),
                "description": str(item.get("description") or "Concrete CMS agent skill"),
                "mimeType": "text/markdown",
            }
        )
    return resources


async def call_skill_tool(corpus_dir: Path, tool: str, args: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    # Compatibility aliases existed briefly during the initial integration and
    # remain accepted, but only canonical skills.* tools are advertised.
    aliases = {
        "runtime.skills_list": "skills.list",
        "runtime.skills_read": "skills.read",
        "runtime.skills_search": "skills.search",
    }
    tool = aliases.get(tool, tool)
    library = _library(corpus_dir)

    if tool == "skills.list":
        return library.list(namespace=args.get("namespace"))
    if tool == "skills.read":
        try:
            return library.read(str(args.get("name", "")))
        except (ValueError, FileNotFoundError) as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404 if isinstance(exc, FileNotFoundError) else 422, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    if tool == "skills.search":
        try:
            return library.search(
                str(args.get("query", "")),
                limit=int(args.get("limit", 8)),
                namespace=args.get("namespace"),
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"unknown skill MCP tool: {tool}")


def _canonical_skill_name(uri: str) -> str | None:
    if uri == "skills://concretecms":
        return ""
    prefix = "skills://concretecms/"
    if uri.startswith(prefix):
        tail = unquote(uri[len(prefix) :]).strip("/")
        if tail.endswith("/skill.md"):
            tail = tail[: -len("/skill.md")]
        return f"concretecms/{tail}" if tail else ""

    if uri == "xavi-runtime://skills/concretecms":
        return ""
    legacy = "xavi-runtime://skills/concretecms/"
    if uri.startswith(legacy):
        return f"concretecms/{unquote(uri[len(legacy):]).strip('/')}"
    return None


async def read_skill_resource(corpus_dir: Path, uri: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    name = _canonical_skill_name(uri)
    if name is None:
        return None
    library = _library(corpus_dir)
    if name == "":
        return {"uri": uri, "mimeType": "application/json", "contents": library.list(namespace="concretecms")}
    try:
        item = library.read(name)
    except (ValueError, FileNotFoundError) as exc:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404 if isinstance(exc, FileNotFoundError) else 422, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    return {
        "uri": uri,
        "mimeType": "text/markdown",
        "contents": item["content"],
        "metadata": {k: v for k, v in item.items() if k != "content"},
    }
PY

# MCP Agent Skill Architecture

The runtime keeps **instructional skills** separate from **executable MCP tools**.

## Layout

```text
corpus/skills/
├── index.json
└── concretecms/
    ├── building-blocktypes/SKILL.md
    ├── building-packages/SKILL.md
    ├── security/SKILL.md
    └── ...
```

Each skill is a directory containing `SKILL.md` and optional `references/` files. Upstream commit and licence metadata are retained in `UPSTREAM.json`.

## Progressive disclosure

1. `skills.list` returns names, descriptions, paths, sizes and SHA-256 digests.
2. `skills.search` returns small matching excerpts.
3. `skills.read` or `resources/read` loads the selected full `SKILL.md`.
4. Operational changes use separate bounded tools such as `dev.concrete_block_scaffold`; skill text never grants write authority.

Canonical resource URIs use:

```text
skills://concretecms
skills://concretecms/building-blocktypes/skill.md
```

The former `runtime.skills_*` tool names and `xavi-runtime://skills/...` resource paths remain accepted as compatibility aliases but are not advertised.

import json, os, urllib.request
base='http://127.0.0.1:8080/mcp'
key=os.environ['XAVI_MCP_API_KEY']
requests=[
 ('tools/list',{}),
 ('resources/list',{}),
 ('resources/read',{'uri':'skills://concretecms/building-blocktypes/skill.md'}),
]

        if method=='tools/list': summary='count='+str(len(result.get('tools',[])))
        elif method=='resources/list': summary='count='+str(len(result.get('resources',[])))

verify_live_fusion_skill_surface.title: Verify live Fusion and skill surface
verify_live_fusion_skill_surface.description: Exercise the live MCP JSON-RPC endpoint: advertised Fusion/skill tools, canonical resources, both skill reads, source catalog, analysis plan and deterministic correlation. Prints summaries only.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/Duotronics/build_docs/runtime/duotronic_srnn_open_runtime-v3
set -a; . ./.env; set +a
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, urllib.request
base='http://127.0.0.1:8080/mcp'
key=os.environ['XAVI_MCP_API_KEY']

def rpc(method, params, ident):
    body=json.dumps({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':ident,'method':method,'params':params}).encode()
    req=urllib.request.Request(base,data=body,headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+key,'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=40) as response:
        payload=json.loads(response.read())
    if 'error' in payload:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{method}: {payload['error']}")
    return payload['result']

def tool(name,args,ident):
    result=rpc('tools/call',{'name':name,'arguments':args},ident)
    content=result.get('content',[])
    if not content: return result
    text=content[0].get('text','')
    try: return json.loads(text)
    except Exception: return {'text':text,'raw_result':result}

tools=rpc('tools/list',{},1)['tools']
resources=rpc('resources/list',{},2)['resources']
fusion=sorted(t['name'] for t in tools if t['name'].startswith('fusion.'))
skill_tools=sorted(t['name'] for t in tools if t['name'].startswith('skills.'))
skill_resources=sorted(r['uri'] for r in resources if r['uri'].startswith('skills://'))
fusion_resources=sorted(r['uri'] for r in resources if r['uri'].startswith('fusion://'))
assert len(fusion)==17, len(fusion)
assert skill_tools==['skills.list','skills.read','skills.search'],skill_tools
assert 'skills://concretecms/building-blocktypes/skill.md' in skill_resources
assert 'skills://fusion-center/osint-fusion-analysis/skill.md' in skill_resources
assert fusion_resources==['fusion://methodology','fusion://sources'],fusion_resources
for ident,uri,needle in [
 (3,'skills://concretecms/building-blocktypes/skill.md','Building Block Types'),
 (4,'skills://fusion-center/osint-fusion-analysis/skill.md','OSINT Fusion Analysis'),
]:
    read=rpc('resources/read',{'uri':uri},ident)['contents'][0]
    assert read['mimeType']=='text/markdown'
    assert needle in read.get('text','')
sources=tool('fusion.sources',{},5)
plan=tool('fusion.plan_analysis',{'task':'Correlate a thermal anomaly, news reports and an internet outage','max_hypotheses':4},6)
correlation=tool('fusion.correlate_records',{
 'records':[
  {'source':'news','timestamp':'2026-08-05T00:00:00Z','latitude':53.9,'longitude':-122.7,'entities':['Prince George','Example']},
  {'source':'weather','timestamp':'2026-08-05T01:00:00Z','latitude':53.91,'longitude':-122.71,'entities':['Prince George']}
 ],
 'time_window_hours':24,'distance_km':50,'minimum_sources':2
},7)
# tools/call wrappers may nest results under structuredContent on some clients.
def unwrap(obj):
    if isinstance(obj,dict) and 'structuredContent' in obj and obj['structuredContent'] is not None: return obj['structuredContent']
    return obj
sources=unwrap(sources); plan=unwrap(plan); correlation=unwrap(correlation)
assert isinstance(sources,dict)
assert isinstance(plan,dict)
assert isinstance(correlation,dict)
print('fusion_tools='+str(len(fusion)))
print('skill_tools='+','.join(skill_tools))
print('skill_resources='+str(len(skill_resources)))
print('fusion_resources='+','.join(fusion_resources))
print('source_catalog_ok='+str('sources' in sources).lower())
print('analysis_plan_ok='+str('stages' in plan).lower())
print('correlation_count='+str(correlation.get('correlation_count','unknown')))
print('live_mcp=PASS')
PY

argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/xavi-geo-search/v2
find data/cms/packages/xavi_fusion_os data/cms/packages/xavi_geo_site data/cms/application/themes/xavi_geo -type f -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l >/tmp/fusion060-php-lint.txt
node --check data/cms/packages/xavi_fusion_os/js/fusion-os.js
set -a; source .env; set +a
COOKIE=/tmp/fusion060-activate.cookies
LOGIN=/tmp/fusion060-login.html
trap 'rm -f "$COOKIE" "$LOGIN" /tmp/fusion060-*' EXIT
curl -ksS -c "$COOKIE" -b "$COOKIE" --max-time 20 https://geo.xavi.app/login -o "$LOGIN"
TOKEN=$(python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
class P(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.value=''
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  a=dict(attrs)
  if tag=='input' and a.get('name')=='ccm_token': self.value=a.get('value','')
p=P(); p.feed(open('/tmp/fusion060-login.html',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read())
if not p.value: raise SystemExit('login token not found')
print(p.value,end='')
PY
)
curl -ksS -L -c "$COOKIE" -b "$COOKIE" -o /tmp/fusion060-auth.html --max-time 40 \
  --data-urlencode "ccm_token=$TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode 'authType=concrete' \
  --data-urlencode 'uName=admin' \
  --data-urlencode "uPassword=$CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD" \
  --data-urlencode 'rememberme=1' \
  https://geo.xavi.app/login/authenticate/concrete >/dev/null
STATUS=$(curl -ksS -c "$COOKIE" -b "$COOKIE" -o /tmp/fusion060-response.json -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 120 \
  -X POST -H 'Accept: application/json' -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' \
  https://geo.xavi.app/xavi-fusion/api/system/repair)
echo "repair_http=$STATUS"
[[ "$STATUS" =~ ^2 ]]
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p=json.load(open('/tmp/fusion060-response.json'))
if not p.get('repaired'): raise SystemExit('repair did not report success')
fusion=p.get('fusion') or {}
geo=p.get('geo_site') or {}
areas=p.get('fusion_page_areas') or {}
assert fusion.get('version')=='0.6.0',fusion
assert geo.get('version')=='2.2.0',geo
installed=set(fusion.get('installed_blocks') or [])
required={'xavi_fusion_taskbar','xavi_workspace_focus','xavi_workspace_metrics','xavi_connector_status'}
# Already installed is acceptable; the approved page and later DB audit prove registration.
main=set(areas.get('Main') or [])
managed={'xavi_fusion_workspace','xavi_project_selector','xavi_dataset_catalog','xavi_workspace_focus','xavi_workspace_metrics','xavi_connector_status','xavi_fusion_patchbay','xavi_fusion_taskbar'}
assert not (main & managed),(main & managed)
assert areas.get('Fusion Taskbar')==['xavi_fusion_taskbar'],areas
for handle in ['Fusion Toolbar','Fusion Main','Fusion Side','Fusion Bottom']:
 assert areas.get(handle,[])==[],(handle,areas.get(handle))
print('fusion_version='+fusion['version'])
print('theme_version='+geo['version'])
print('newly_installed_blocks='+','.join(sorted(installed & required)) if installed & required else 'already_registered')
print('main_managed_blocks=0')
print('taskbar_area=xavi_fusion_taskbar')
print('activation=PASS')
PY

argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/xavi-geo-search/v2
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import secrets,re,os
root=Path('/var/www/xavi/xavi-geo-search/v2')
runtime=root/'data/cms/packages/xavi_fusion_os/config/runtime.php'
s=runtime.read_text()
m=re.search(r"'automation_token'\s*=>\s*'([^']+)'",s)
token=m.group(1) if m else secrets.token_urlsafe(48)
if not m:
    s=s.replace("\n);\n", "\n  'automation_token' => '"+token+"',\n);\n")
    runtime.write_text(s)
env=root/'data/fusion-os/automation.env'
env.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
env.write_text('XAVI_AUTOMATION_TOKEN='+token+'\n')
os.chmod(env,0o600)

verify_restored_profiles_live.title: Verify restored profiles
verify_restored_profiles_live.description: Confirm rollback markers are gone, clear writable caches without ownership changes, verify live assets/routes, and inspect recent CMS profile requests.
argv:
set -euo pipefail
cd /var/www/xavi/xavi-geo-search/v2
ROOT=data/cms/packages/xavi_fusion_os

echo '== rollback markers =='
grep -n "pkgVersion" "$ROOT/controller.php" | head -1
if grep -qE 'discoverSources|syncTrustedSources|setGlobalState' "$ROOT/src/Xavi/FusionOS/ApplicationPackageService.php"; then echo service_rollback=FAIL; exit 1; else echo service_rollback=PASS; fi
if grep -qE 'profilePinsEnabled|packageSettings|reloadAppsIfStale' "$ROOT/js/fusion-os.js"; then echo js_rollback=FAIL; exit 1; else echo js_rollback=PASS; fi
if grep -q 'data-app-pin' "$ROOT/single_pages/account/xavi_profile.php"; then echo profile_rollback=FAIL; exit 1; else echo profile_rollback=PASS; fi

echo '== clear cache =='
find data/cms/application/files/cache -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
find data/cms/application/files/tmp -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true

echo '== live JS =='
body=$(curl -sk --max-time 20 "https://geo.xavi.app/packages/xavi_fusion_os/js/fusion-os.js?rollback=$(date +%s)")
printf 'bytes=%s\n' "${#body}"
if grep -qE 'profilePinsEnabled|packageSettings|reloadAppsIfStale' <<<"$body"; then echo live_js_rollback=FAIL; exit 1; else echo live_js_rollback=PASS; fi

echo '== routes =='
for url in \
 'https://geo.xavi.app/account/xavi-profile' \
 'https://geo.xavi.app/index.php/account/xavi-profile' \
 'https://geo.xavi.app/login'; do
  printf '%s -> ' "$url"
  curl -sk -o /tmp/xavi-route-body -D /tmp/xavi-route-head --max-time 20 "$url"
  code=$(awk 'toupper($1) ~ /^HTTP/ {c=$2} END{print c}' /tmp/xavi-route-head)
  loc=$(awk 'tolower($1)=="location:" {print $2}' /tmp/xavi-route-head | tr -d '\r' | tail -1)
  printf '%s %s body=%s\n' "$code" "$loc" "$(wc -c </tmp/xavi-route-body)"
done

echo '== recent CMS profile requests =='
journalctl --since '20 minutes ago' --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep 'xavi_geo_search_cms_1' | grep -E 'xavi-profile|account/|login|PHP Fatal|Uncaught|Exception' | tail -n 120 || true

echo verify_complete=1

import json,sys,datetime
from pathlib import Path
stage=Path(sys.argv[1])
meta={
 'package':'js-dos',
 'version':'8.4.1',
 'source':'npm:js-dos@8.4.1',
 'license':'GPL-2.0',
 'tarball_sha256':sys.argv[2],
 'installed_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'files':sum(1 for p in stage.rglob('*') if p.is_file()),
 'bytes':sum(p.stat().st_size for p in stage.rglob('*') if p.is_file()),
}
(stage/'XAVI-PROVENANCE.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n')

PY

argv:

cat > db/migrations/20260805_fusion_chat.sql <<'SQL'
BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fusion.chat_conversation (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('direct','group')),
    title varchar(190) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    direct_key varchar(190) UNIQUE,
    created_by_id text NOT NULL,
    created_by_username varchar(190) NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_message_id bigint,
    metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fusion.chat_participant (
    conversation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES fusion.chat_conversation(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id text NOT NULL,
    username varchar(190) NOT NULL,
    display_name varchar(190) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    role text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member' CHECK (role IN ('owner','admin','member')),
    joined_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_read_message_id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    muted_until timestamptz,
    archived boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    PRIMARY KEY (conversation_id, user_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS chat_participant_user_idx ON fusion.chat_participant(user_id, archived, conversation_id);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fusion.chat_message (
    id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
    conversation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES fusion.chat_conversation(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    sender_id text NOT NULL,
    sender_username varchar(190) NOT NULL,
    body text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    kind text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text' CHECK (kind IN ('text','system','image','file')),
    reply_to_message_id bigint REFERENCES fusion.chat_message(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    attachment jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    edited_at timestamptz,
    deleted_at timestamptz
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS chat_message_conversation_idx ON fusion.chat_message(conversation_id, id DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS chat_message_sender_idx ON fusion.chat_message(sender_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fusion.chat_reaction (
    message_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES fusion.chat_message(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id text NOT NULL,
    emoji varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (message_id, user_id, emoji)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fusion.chat_user_setting (
    user_id text PRIMARY KEY,
    username varchar(190) NOT NULL,
    availability text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'online' CHECK (availability IN ('online','away','busy','offline')),

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

from fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException, Query, WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from psycopg.types.json import Jsonb

from .auth import Authenticated, UserContext, _decode_bearer
from .db import connection

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/chat", tags=["chat"])


class DirectCreate(BaseModel):
    user_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    username: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=190)
    display_name: str = Field(default="", max_length=190)


class GroupCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=190)
    participants: list[DirectCreate] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=100)


class MessageCreate(BaseModel):
    body: str = Field(default="", max_length=8000)
    kind: str = Field(default="text", pattern="^(text|image|file)$")
    reply_to_message_id: int | None = None
    attachment: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class MessageEdit(BaseModel):
    body: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=8000)


class ReactionUpdate(BaseModel):

class SettingsUpdate(BaseModel):
    availability: str | None = Field(default=None, pattern="^(online|away|busy|offline)$")
    allow_direct_messages: bool | None = None
    read_receipts: bool | None = None
    sound_enabled: bool | None = None
    footer_enabled: bool | None = None
    chat_heads_enabled: bool | None = None
    compact_mode: bool | None = None


def _user_from_token(token: str) -> UserContext:
    claims = _decode_bearer(token)
    scope_value = claims.get("scope", "")
    scopes = frozenset(str(x) for x in claims.get("scopes", []) if x)
    if isinstance(scope_value, str):
        scopes |= frozenset(scope_value.split())
    groups = frozenset(str(x) for x in claims.get("groups", []) if x)
    username = str(claims.get("preferred_username") or "").strip()
    if not username:
        raise ValueError("JWT username claim is missing")
    return UserContext(
        user_id=str(claims["sub"]),
        username=username,
        email=str(claims.get("email")) if claims.get("email") else None,
        groups=groups,
        scopes=scopes,
        claims=claims,
    )


def _ensure_settings(cur: Any, user: UserContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cur.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO fusion.chat_user_setting (user_id, username)
        VALUES (%s, %s)
        ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET username = EXCLUDED.username
        RETURNING user_id, username, availability, allow_direct_messages,
                  read_receipts, sound_enabled, footer_enabled,
                  chat_heads_enabled, compact_mode, last_seen_at, updated_at
        """,
        (user.user_id, user.username),
    )
    return cur.fetchone()


def _require_participant(cur: Any, conversation_id: UUID, user: UserContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT p.*, c.kind, c.title, c.created_by_id
        FROM fusion.chat_participant p
        JOIN fusion.chat_conversation c ON c.id = p.conversation_id
        WHERE p.conversation_id = %s AND p.user_id = %s
        """,
        (conversation_id, user.user_id),
    )
    row = cur.fetchone()
    if row is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="conversation membership is required")
    return row


def _member_ids(conversation_id: UUID) -> list[str]:
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("SELECT user_id FROM fusion.chat_participant WHERE conversation_id = %s", (conversation_id,))
        return [str(row["user_id"]) for row in cur.fetchall()]


def _message_payload(cur: Any, message_id: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT m.id, m.conversation_id, m.sender_id, m.sender_username,
               CASE WHEN m.deleted_at IS NULL THEN m.body ELSE '' END AS body,
               m.kind, m.reply_to_message_id,
               CASE WHEN m.deleted_at IS NULL THEN m.attachment ELSE '{}'::jsonb END AS attachment,
               m.created_at, m.edited_at, m.deleted_at,
               COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('emoji', r.emoji, 'user_id', r.user_id) ORDER BY r.created_at)
                         FROM fusion.chat_reaction r WHERE r.message_id = m.id), '[]'::jsonb) AS reactions
        FROM fusion.chat_message m WHERE m.id = %s
        """,
        (message_id,),
    )
    row = cur.fetchone()
    if row is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="message not found")
    return row


def _conversation_payload(cur: Any, conversation_id: UUID, user_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cur.execute(
        """
        SELECT c.id, c.kind, c.title, c.created_by_id, c.created_by_username,
               c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.last_message_id, p.role,
               p.last_read_message_id, p.muted_until, p.archived
        FROM fusion.chat_conversation c
        JOIN fusion.chat_participant p ON p.conversation_id = c.id AND p.user_id = %s
        WHERE c.id = %s
        """,
        (user_id, conversation_id),
    )
    row = cur.fetchone()
    if row is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="conversation not found")
    cur.execute(
        """SELECT user_id, username, display_name, role, joined_at, last_read_message_id
           FROM fusion.chat_participant WHERE conversation_id = %s ORDER BY joined_at""",
        (conversation_id,),
    )
    row["participants"] = list(cur.fetchall())
    row["last_message"] = _message_payload(cur, int(row["last_message_id"])) if row["last_message_id"] else None
    cur.execute(
        """SELECT count(*) AS count FROM fusion.chat_message
           WHERE conversation_id = %s AND id > %s AND sender_id <> %s AND deleted_at IS NULL""",
        (conversation_id, int(row["last_read_message_id"] or 0), user_id),
    )
    row["unread_count"] = int(cur.fetchone()["count"])
    return row


def _list_conversations(user: UserContext) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(
            """
            SELECT c.id FROM fusion.chat_conversation c
            JOIN fusion.chat_participant p ON p.conversation_id = c.id
            WHERE p.user_id = %s AND p.archived = false
            ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
            """,
            (user.user_id,),
        )
        return [_conversation_payload(cur, row["id"], user.user_id) for row in cur.fetchall()]


class ChatHub:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.connections: dict[str, set[WebSocket]] = defaultdict(set)
        self.users: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self.lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def connect(self, user: UserContext, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:
        await websocket.accept(subprotocol="xavi-chat-v1")
        async with self.lock:
            self.connections[user.user_id].add(websocket)
            self.users[user.user_id] = {"user_id": user.user_id, "username": user.username, "online": True}
        await self.broadcast_all({"type": "presence", "user": self.users[user.user_id]})

    async def disconnect(self, user: UserContext, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:
        async with self.lock:
            sockets = self.connections.get(user.user_id)
            if sockets:
                sockets.discard(websocket)
                if not sockets:
                    self.connections.pop(user.user_id, None)
                    self.users[user.user_id] = {"user_id": user.user_id, "username": user.username, "online": False}
        if user.user_id not in self.connections:
            with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
                cur.execute("UPDATE fusion.chat_user_setting SET last_seen_at = now() WHERE user_id = %s", (user.user_id,))
                conn.commit()
            await self.broadcast_all({"type": "presence", "user": self.users[user.user_id]})

    async def send_users(self, user_ids: list[str], payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        targets: list[WebSocket] = []
        async with self.lock:
            for user_id in set(user_ids):
                targets.extend(self.connections.get(user_id, set()))
        for websocket in targets:
            try:
                await websocket.send_json(payload)
            except Exception:
                pass

    async def broadcast_all(self, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        async with self.lock:
            targets = [ws for sockets in self.connections.values() for ws in sockets]
        for websocket in targets:
            try:
                await websocket.send_json(payload)
            except Exception:
                pass

    async def conversation(self, conversation_id: UUID, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        await self.send_users(_member_ids(conversation_id), payload)


hub = ChatHub()

@router.post("/direct", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_direct(payload: DirectCreate, user: Authenticated) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if payload.user_id == user.user_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="a direct conversation requires another user")
    direct_key = ":".join(sorted([user.user_id, payload.user_id]))
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute("SELECT 1 FROM fusion.chat_block WHERE (blocker_id=%s AND blocked_id=%s) OR (blocker_id=%s AND blocked_id=%s)", (user.user_id, payload.user_id, payload.user_id, user.user_id))
        if cur.fetchone():
            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="direct messaging is blocked")
        cur.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO fusion.chat_conversation (kind, direct_key, created_by_id, created_by_username)
            VALUES ('direct', %s, %s, %s)
            ON CONFLICT (direct_key) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = fusion.chat_conversation.updated_at
            RETURNING id
            """,
            (direct_key, user.user_id, user.username),
        )
        conversation_id = cur.fetchone()["id"]
        for uid, username, display, role in [
            (user.user_id, user.username, user.username, "owner"),
            (payload.user_id, payload.username, payload.display_name or payload.username, "member"),
        ]:
            cur.execute(
                """INSERT INTO fusion.chat_participant (conversation_id,user_id,username,display_name,role)
                   VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) ON CONFLICT (conversation_id,user_id) DO UPDATE
                   SET username=EXCLUDED.username, display_name=EXCLUDED.display_name""",
                (conversation_id, uid, username, display, role),
            )
        result = _conversation_payload(cur, conversation_id, user.user_id)
        conn.commit()
    await hub.send_users([user.user_id, payload.user_id], {"type": "conversation.created", "conversation_id": str(conversation_id)})
    return result


@router.post("/groups", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_group(payload: GroupCreate, user: Authenticated) -> dict[str, Any]:
    unique = {p.user_id: p for p in payload.participants if p.user_id != user.user_id}
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        cur.execute(
            """INSERT INTO fusion.chat_conversation (kind,title,created_by_id,created_by_username)
               VALUES ('group',%s,%s,%s) RETURNING id""",
            (payload.title.strip(), user.user_id, user.username),
        )
        conversation_id = cur.fetchone()["id"]
        members = [(user.user_id, user.username, user.username, "owner")] + [(p.user_id, p.username, p.display_name or p.username, "member") for p in unique.values()]
        for uid, username, display, role in members:
            cur.execute("INSERT INTO fusion.chat_participant (conversation_id,user_id,username,display_name,role) VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)", (conversation_id, uid, username, display, role))
        result = _conversation_payload(cur, conversation_id, user.user_id)
        conn.commit()
    await hub.send_users([x[0] for x in members], {"type": "conversation.created", "conversation_id": str(conversation_id)})
    return result


@router.get("/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages")
def messages(conversation_id: UUID, user: Authenticated, before: int | None = None, limit: int = Query(default=60, ge=1, le=200)) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        _require_participant(cur, conversation_id, user)
        params: list[Any] = [conversation_id]
        condition = ""
        if before is not None:
            condition = "AND m.id < %s"
            params.append(before)
        params.append(limit)
        cur.execute(
            f"""SELECT m.id FROM fusion.chat_message m WHERE m.conversation_id=%s {condition}
                ORDER BY m.id DESC LIMIT %s""",
            tuple(params),
        )
        ids = [int(row["id"]) for row in cur.fetchall()]
        return [_message_payload(cur, mid) for mid in reversed(ids)]


@router.post("/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def send_message(conversation_id: UUID, payload: MessageCreate, user: Authenticated) -> dict[str, Any]:
    body = payload.body.strip()
    if not body and not payload.attachment:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="message text or an attachment is required")
    with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
        _require_participant(cur, conversation_id, user)
        if payload.reply_to_message_id:
            cur.execute("SELECT 1 FROM fusion.chat_message WHERE id=%s AND conversation_id=%s", (payload.reply_to_message_id, conversation_id))
            if cur.fetchone() is None:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="reply target is not in this conversation")
        cur.execute(
            """INSERT INTO fusion.chat_message (conversation_id,sender_id,sender_username,body,kind,reply_to_message_id,attachment)
               VALUES (%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) RETURNING id""",
            (conversation_id, user.user_id, user.username, body, payload.kind, payload.reply_to_message_id, Jsonb(payload.attachment)),
        )
        message_id = int(cur.fetchone()["id"])
        cur.execute("UPDATE fusion.chat_conversation SET last_message_id=%s,updated_at=now() WHERE id=%s", (message_id, conversation_id))
        cur.execute("UPDATE fusion.chat_participant SET last_read_message_id=%s WHERE conversation_id=%s AND user_id=%s", (message_id, conversation_id, user.user_id))
        result = _message_payload(cur, message_id)
        conn.commit()
    await hub.conversation(conversation_id, {"type": "message.created", "conversation_id": str(conversation_id), "message": result})
    return result


@router.patch("/messages/{message_id}")

            raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="message edit is not permitted")
        cur.execute("UPDATE fusion.chat_message SET body=%s,edited_at=now() WHERE id=%s", (payload.body.strip(), message_id))

@router.post("/messages/{message_id}/reaction")

@router.websocket("/ws")
async def websocket_chat(websocket: WebSocket) -> None:
    protocols = list(websocket.scope.get("subprotocols") or [])
    token = next((value for value in protocols if value != "xavi-chat-v1"), "")
    try:
        user = _user_from_token(token)
    except Exception:
        await websocket.close(code=4401, reason="invalid Concrete CMS token")
        return
    await hub.connect(user, websocket)
    try:
        await websocket.send_json({"type": "socket.ready", "user_id": user.user_id, "online": list(hub.users.values())})
        while True:
            event = await websocket.receive_json()
            event_type = str(event.get("type") or "")
            if event_type == "ping":
                await websocket.send_json({"type": "pong", "at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})
                continue
            if event_type == "typing":
                try:
                    conversation_id = UUID(str(event.get("conversation_id")))
                except Exception:
                    continue
                with connection() as conn, conn.cursor() as cur:
                    try:
                        _require_participant(cur, conversation_id, user)
                    except HTTPException:
                        continue
                await hub.conversation(conversation_id, {"type": "typing", "conversation_id": str(conversation_id), "user_id": user.user_id, "username": user.username, "active": bool(event.get("active", True))})
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        pass
    finally:
        await hub.disconnect(user, websocket)

#!/usr/bin/env python3

import requests

def env(name):
 for raw in (ROOT/'.env').read_text().splitlines():
  if raw and not raw.lstrip().startswith('#') and '=' in raw:
   k,v=raw.split('=',1)
   if k==name:return v.strip().strip('"\'')
 return ''
class P(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self):super().__init__();self.forms=[];self.cur=None
 def handle_starttag(self,t,a):
  d={k:(v or '') for k,v in a}
  if t=='form':self.cur={'action':d.get('action',''),'inputs':{}};self.forms.append(self.cur)
  elif t=='input' and self.cur is not None and d.get('name'):self.cur['inputs'][d['name']]=d.get('value','')
 def handle_endtag(self,t):
  if t=='form':self.cur=None
def login():
 s=requests.Session();s.verify=False;requests.packages.urllib3.disable_warnings()
 password=env('CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD');email=env('CMS_ADMIN_EMAIL')
 for candidate in ['admin',email]:
  r=s.get(BASE+'/login',timeout=20);p=P();p.feed(r.text);f=p.forms[0]
  s.post(urljoin(BASE,f['action']),data={'uName':candidate,'uPassword':password,'uMaintainLogin':'0','ccm_token':f['inputs']['ccm_token']},allow_redirects=False,timeout=20)
  check=s.get(BASE+'/xavi-fusion/api/session',timeout=20)
  if check.status_code==200:return s,check.json()
 raise RuntimeError('administrator login failed')
def req(s,method,path,**kwargs):
 r=s.request(method,BASE+path,timeout=40,**kwargs);print(f'{method} {path} -> {r.status_code} {r.headers.get("Content-Type","")} bytes={len(r.content)}');return r
def main():
 s,session=login();print('authenticated',session.get('username'),session.get('id'))

 target=people[0];print('target',target['username'],target['id'])
 bootstrap=req(s,'GET','/xavi-fusion/api/chat-data/bootstrap');assert bootstrap.status_code==200;boot=bootstrap.json();assert boot['user']['username']=='admin' and 'settings' in boot and 'conversations' in boot

 for path,marker in [('/packages/xavi_fusion_os/js/messenger.js',"customElements.define('xavi-messenger-app'"),('/packages/xavi_fusion_os/css/messenger.css','.messenger-shell')]:
  r=req(s,'GET',path);assert r.status_code==200 and marker in r.text
 conversation_id=None;message_id=None;old_settings=boot['settings']
 try:
